map.输入载荷、轴径、宽径比、转速及要求寿命，计算 pV 值并推荐轴承类型与所需额定动: Enter the load, shaft diameter, width-to-diameter ratio, speed and required life to compute the pV value and recommend the bearing type and required dynamic load rating
map.轴承额定动载 C = f(寿命, 转速): Bearing dynamic load rating C = f(life, speed)
map.💡 滑动轴承：p=F/(d·B)；v=πdn/60×10⁻³(m/s)；pV 值: 💡 Plain bearing: p=F/(d·B); v=πdn/60×10⁻³ (m/s); pV value check; rolling bearing: required C=P·(Lh·60n/10⁶)^(1/3)
map.滑动轴承许用 pV 值：锡青铜 8~12，铅青铜 12~20，铝青铜 20~30: Plain bearing allowable pV values: tin bronze 8-12, lead bronze 12-20, aluminium bronze 20-30, babbitt 6-10 (MPa·m/s)
map.滚动轴承适用于中低速高精度场合，滑动轴承适用于高速重载或剖分结构: Rolling bearings suit medium-to-low speed, high-precision applications; plain bearings suit high-speed, heavy-load or split constructions
map.宽径比 B/d 一般取 0.5~1.5，常用 0.8~1.0: The width-to-diameter ratio B/d is usually 0.5-1.5, commonly 0.8-1.0
map.滚动轴承所需额定动载荷 C 为球轴承计算（指数3），滚子轴承应使用指数 10/3: The required dynamic load rating C for rolling bearings is computed for a ball bearing (exponent 3); roller bearings should use the exponent 10/3

map.宽径比 B/d 取值合理性。: Reasonableness of the width-to-diameter ratio B/d.
map.F=8 kN、d=50 mm、B/d=0.8→B=40 mm、v=2 m/s：p: F=8 kN, d=50 mm, B/d=0.8→B=40 mm, v=2 m/s: p=8000/(50×40)=4 MPa; pV=4×2=8 MPa·m/s, below the babbitt allowable (about 10-15), so it passes.
map.B/d 常取 0.5–1.5；过小压强高、过大端泄大。上例 0.8 合理。: B/d is usually 0.5-1.5; too small gives high pressure, too large gives excessive end leakage. The 0.8 in the example is reasonable.
map.滑动轴承为何看 pV？: Why look at pV for a plain bearing?
map.pV 正比于摩擦发热功率密度，超限则油膜破裂、抱轴，是滑动轴承核心限制。: pV is proportional to the frictional heat-generation power density; exceeding the limit ruptures the oil film and seizes the shaft, making it the core limit of a plain bearing.
map.与滚动轴承寿命区别？: What is the difference from rolling bearing life?
map.滚动轴承用 L10 疲劳寿命（转数）；滑动轴承按 pV 与磨损/温升，不称\"转: Rolling bearings use the L10 fatigue life (in revolutions); plain bearings are governed by pV and wear/temperature rise and are not termed a "revolution life".
